description: PowerShell cmdlet to retrieve Microsoft Defender Antivirus health, protection state, and signature status locally or remotely.
prerequisites: WinRM enabled for remote CIM sessions

flags.purpose: Query Defender status on remote endpoints via CIM sessions.
flags.outputs: Per-host Defender health and signature data.
flags.threat_detected: Disabled AV, disabled real-time protection, outdated signatures.
flags.risk_if_misused: Requires proper permissions and WinRM exposure.
flags.safe_followup: Re-enable protections, update signatures, investigate root cause.

flags.purpose: Control concurrency when querying many hosts to avoid resource exhaustion.
flags.outputs: Same as default query with controlled parallelism.
flags.security_use_case: Safe enterprise querying without overloading endpoints.
flags.risk_if_misused: Too high may stress network/hosts; too low slows audits.

health_interpretation.IoavProtectionEnabled_false: Web/download scanning disabled — malware ingress risk
